title: 1. 三日 あとです
english_summary: Takashi realizes his mother's birthday is only three days away — and he has almost no money. Hana declares it a plan just between the two of them.
content:
朝ごはんの まえ、たかしは 新聞を 見ました。
新聞の 日を 見ました。
たかし：あ！
日よう日は お母さんの たんじょうびです。
三日 あとです。
でも、たかしは 何も ありません。
学校で、たかしは はなに 話しました。
たかし：日よう日は 母の たんじょうびです。
はな：えっ、いいですね！何を しますか？
たかし：わかりません…お金も 少ないです。
はな：うーん…
はな：じゃあ、これは 二人だけです！
たかし：二人だけ…？
はな：そうです。お母さんは 何も 聞きません。
はな：日よう日に、みんなで 「おめでとう」を 言います。
たかし：いいですね！でも、何を しますか？
はな：あしたも 話しましょう。
その 夜、お母さんは たかしに 聞きました。
おかあさん：今日、学校は どうでしたか？
たかし：え？な、何も ありません！
おかあさん：…そうですか。
でも、お母さんは たかしを ちょっと 見ました。
english_content:
Before breakfast, Takashi looked at the newspaper.
He looked at the date on the newspaper.
Takashi: Ah!
Sunday is his mother's birthday.
It's three days away.
But Takashi has nothing.
At school, Takashi told Hana.
Takashi: Sunday is my mom's birthday.
Hana: Oh, how nice! What will you do?
Takashi: I don't know… and I have very little money.
Hana: Hmm…
Hana: Then this is just between the two of us!
Takashi: Just… the two of us?
Hana: Yes. Your mom must hear nothing.
Hana: On Sunday, we all say "congratulations".
Takashi: Sounds great! But what will we do?
Hana: Let's talk more tomorrow.
That night, his mother asked Takashi:
Mother: How was school today?
Takashi: Huh? N-nothing at all!
Mother: …I see.
But his mother gave Takashi a little look.

title: 2. 小さい お金の 買いもの
english_summary: At the shop everything nice is too expensive for Takashi's little money — until he realizes the best present might not be something you can buy.
content:
つぎの 日、二人は 店へ 行きました。
はな：この 店は 何でも ありますよ。
たかしは きれいな ぼうしを 見ました。
たかし：あ、母は ぼうしが すきです。
でも、ぼうしは とても 高いです。
たかし：高い…買いません。
はなは 小さい とけいを 見ました。
はな：これは どうですか？
たかし：それも 高いです。
二人は 店の 中を 歩きました。
安い ものは、いい ものでは ありません。
いい ものは、高いです。
たかし：私の お金は 少ないです…
はな：うーん、そうですね。
その あとで、たかしは 花の 店を 見ました。
小さくて 赤い 花が ありました。
花は 安いです。
たかし：花と…それから、手紙は どうですか？
たかし：手紙は、お金では 買いません。
はな：いいですね！えも かきましょう！
たかしは 花を 買いました。
お金が ちょっと あります。
はな：その お金で、おかしも 買いましょう。
english_content:
The next day, the two went to a shop.
Hana: This shop has everything.
Takashi looked at a pretty hat.
Takashi: Ah, my mom likes hats.
But the hat is very expensive.
Takashi: Too expensive… I won't buy it.
Hana looked at a small clock.
Hana: How about this?
Takashi: That's expensive too.
The two walked around the shop.
The cheap things are not nice things.
The nice things are expensive.
Takashi: My money is so little…
Hana: Hmm, that's true.
After that, Takashi saw a flower shop.
There were small red flowers.
The flowers are cheap.
Takashi: A flower and… how about a letter?
Takashi: A letter is something money can't buy.
Hana: Great! Let's draw a picture too!
Takashi bought a flower.
He has a little money left.
Hana: With that money, let's buy sweets too.

title: 3. おじいさんの しゃしん
english_summary: The old neighbor shows Takashi a photo of his mother as a little girl — in the park, on her birthday, long ago. Now Takashi knows exactly where the party should be.
content:
夜、たかしは おじいさんの 家へ 行きました。
たかし：こんばんは。ちょっと いいですか？
おじいさん：ああ、たかしさん。どうぞ、どうぞ。
たかし：日よう日は 母の たんじょうびです。
おじいさん：ほう、そうですか。
たかし：おじいさんは、子どもの 母を 見ましたか？
おじいさん：ええ、見ましたよ。この まちの 子どもでした。
おじいさんは 古い しゃしんを 出しました。
小さい 女の 子が こうえんに いました。
たかし：これは…母ですか？
おじいさん：そうです。たんじょうびの 日ですよ。
しゃしんの 中で、母は 花と いっしょでした。
とても たのしい 目でした。
おじいさん：お母さんは この こうえんが すきでした。
おじいさん：毎年、ここで たんじょうびを しました。
たかし：わかりました！
たかし：日よう日、こうえんで します！
おじいさん：いいですね。私も 行きますよ。
たかし：この しゃしん、ちょっと いいですか？
おじいさん：どうぞ、どうぞ。
たかしは しゃしんと いっしょに 家へ かえりました。
english_content:
In the evening, Takashi went to the old neighbor's house.
Takashi: Good evening. Do you have a moment?
Old man: Ah, Takashi. Come in, come in.
Takashi: Sunday is my mom's birthday.
Old man: Oh, is that so.
Takashi: Did you ever see my mom as a child?
Old man: Yes, I did. She was a child of this town.
The old man took out an old photograph.
A little girl was in the park.
Takashi: Is this… my mom?
Old man: Yes. On her birthday.
In the photo, his mother was together with flowers.
She had very happy eyes.
Old man: Your mother loved this park.
Old man: Every year, she had her birthday here.
Takashi: I've got it!
Takashi: On Sunday, we'll do it in the park!
Old man: Wonderful. I will come too.
Takashi: May I borrow this photo?
Old man: Please, please.
Takashi went home together with the photograph.

title: 4. 雨、雨、雨
english_summary: Sunday morning: rain. The park plan is ruined — or is it? While Hana takes Mother out under an umbrella, the boys turn the house into the park.
content:
日よう日の 朝でした。
たかしは まどを 見ました。
雨、雨、雨です。
たかし：あ…こうえんは…
でも、電話が ありました。
はな：たかしさん、だいじょうぶですよ！
たかし：えっ、どうしてですか？
はな：今日は、家の 中が こうえんです！
はな：私は お母さんと 外へ 行きます。
はな：おじいさんと、へやを きれいに して ください。
はなは たかしの 家へ 来ました。
はな：おかあさん、いっしょに 買いものへ 行きませんか？
おかあさん：雨ですよ？
はな：かさが ありますから、だいじょうぶです！
二人は 出ました。
それから、たかしと おじいさんは とても いそがしいです。
つくえの 上に 白い 紙。
紙の 上に、はなの えと たかしの 手紙。
花と おかしと おちゃ。
それから、おじいさんの 古い しゃしん。
おじいさん：いい こうえんですね。
たかし：あ！二人が かえりました！
english_content:
It was Sunday morning.
Takashi looked at the window.
Rain, rain, rain.
Takashi: Ah… the park is…
But then, there was a phone call.
Hana: Takashi, it's all right!
Takashi: Huh, why?
Hana: Today, the inside of the house is the park!
Hana: I will go out with your mom.
Hana: Please make the room beautiful with the old man.
Hana came to Takashi's house.
Hana: Ma'am, won't you go shopping with me?
Mother: But it's raining?
Hana: We have umbrellas, so it's fine!
The two went out.
After that, Takashi and the old man are very busy.
White paper on the table.
On the paper, Hana's drawing and Takashi's letter.
Flowers, sweets and tea.
And the old man's old photograph.
Old man: A fine park, isn't it.
Takashi: Ah! The two are coming back!

title: 5. 小さい こうえん
english_summary: Mother walks into a living room turned into the park of her childhood photo. The letter says what presents can't — and the rain outside doesn't matter at all.
content:
お母さんは 家に 入りました。
みんな：たんじょうび、おめでとうございます！
おかあさん：えっ！？
お母さんは つくえを 見ました。
花、おかし、え、手紙…
それから、あの 古い しゃしん。
おかあさん：この しゃしん…！
おじいさん：あの こうえんですよ。
おかあさん：私の こうえん…
たかし：雨ですから、こうえんは ここです。
たかし：小さい こうえんです。
お母さんは 手紙を 読みました。
「お母さん、いつも ありがとうございます。」
「お母さんの 子どもで、私は たのしいです。」
お母さんの 目に、雨が ありました。
おかあさん：…これは 雨では ありませんよ。
みんなは 「はは！」と 言いました。
それから、みんなで おかしを 食べました。
外は 雨でした。
でも、家の 中は はれでした。
おかあさん：一ばん いい たんじょうびです。
小さい お金の、大きい たんじょうびでした。
english_content:
Mother came into the house.
Everyone: Happy birthday!
Mother: What!?
Mother looked at the table.
Flowers, sweets, a drawing, a letter…
And that old photograph.
Mother: This photo…!
Old man: That park, you know.
Mother: My park…
Takashi: Because of the rain, the park is here.
Takashi: It's a small park.
Mother read the letter.
"Mom, thank you for everything, always."
"Being your child makes me happy."
In Mother's eyes, there was rain.
Mother: …This is not rain, you know.
Everyone said "Haha!"
Then everyone ate the sweets together.
Outside it was raining.
But inside the house, it was sunny.
Mother: This is the best birthday.
A little money — a big birthday.

title: 放学以后
english_summary: Two classmates make an after-school plan over text.
content:
小明：你好！你现在忙吗？
朋友：不忙，怎么了？
小明：放学以后，我们一起去公园吧。
朋友：好啊！我也想去。
小明：我们几点去？
朋友：四点，好吗？
小明：好，四点在学校门口见。
朋友：没问题，一会儿见！

title: 今天吃什么
english_summary: A quick chat about what to eat for dinner.
content:
妈妈：你今天想吃什么？
小明：我想吃面条。
妈妈：家里没有面条了。
小明：那我们吃米饭和鸡蛋，好吗？
妈妈：好。你饿了吗？
小明：有一点饿。
妈妈：那我现在做饭。
小明：谢谢妈妈！

title: 周末做什么
english_summary: Two friends compare weekend plans.
content:
朋友：这个周末你有空吗？
小明：有空。你想做什么？
朋友：我想去看电影。
小明：好主意！看什么电影？
朋友：一个新的中国电影，听说很好看。
小明：几点的？
朋友：星期六下午三点。
小明：太好了，我们一起去！

title: 下雨天
english_summary: A rainy-day walk in the park, told scene by scene.
content:
🌧️ 今天下雨了。
🌂 小明拿着雨伞。
🌳 他去公园走路。
🐦 树上有小鸟。
🌸 雨里的花很美。
😊 小明很开心。
english_content:
It is raining today.
Xiaoming is holding an umbrella.
He goes to walk in the park.
There are little birds in the tree.
The flowers in the rain are beautiful.
Xiaoming is very happy.

title: 我的早上
english_summary: One quiet morning, one scene at a time.
content:
☀️ 早上七点了。
🛏️ 小明起床了。
🪥 他刷牙洗脸。
🍞 他吃面包喝牛奶。
🎒 他拿书包上学。
🚌 他坐公共汽车。
english_content:
It is seven in the morning.
Xiaoming gets out of bed.
He brushes his teeth and washes his face.
He eats bread and drinks milk.
He takes his backpack to school.
He rides the bus.

title: 在动物园
english_summary: An afternoon at the zoo, animal by animal.
content:
🦁 这是一只狮子。
🐼 那是一只熊猫。
🐒 猴子在树上玩。
🐘 大象很大很高。
🍦 我们吃了冰淇淋。
📸 妈妈拍了照片。
english_content:
This is a lion.
That is a panda.
The monkey is playing in the tree.
The elephant is very big and tall.
We ate ice cream.
Mom took a photo.

title: 放学以后聊天
english_summary: Reply inside a chat: make an after-school plan with a friend.
content:
朋友：你今天去学校吗？
小明：去，我现在在学校。
朋友：放学以后你想做什么？
小明：我想去公园。
朋友：好啊，我们几点去？
小明：四点，在学校门口见。

1.pinyin: Wǒ bú qù, wǒ zài jiā.

title: 周末的电影
english_summary: Reply inside a chat: agree on a weekend movie.
content:
朋友：这个周末你有空吗？
小明：有空，你想做什么？
朋友：我想去看电影。
小明：好主意！看什么电影？
朋友：一个新的中国电影。
小明：太好了，几点的？

title: 回家的路
english_summary: After years in the city, Xiaochuan goes back to the village and finds the old bridge — and his parents — still waiting.
content:
小川在大城市工作了很久。
每天都很忙，压力也很大。
今天早上，他终于决定回家看看。
火车很慢，外边的世界很美丽。
到了村里，阳光正好。
他看见了那个旧桥。
桥还在，一点儿也没有变化。
父母正在桥上等他。
妈妈：小川，你回来了！
母亲突然笑了，眼前都是光。
小川心里想，这就是幸福。
有些东西，很久也不会消失。
english_content:
Xiaochuan had worked in the big city for a long time.
Every day was busy, and the pressure was heavy.
This morning, he finally decided to go home for a visit.
The train was slow, and the world outside was beautiful.
When he reached the village, the sunlight was just right.
He saw that old bridge.
The bridge was still there — not changed at all.
His parents were waiting for him on the bridge.
Mum: Xiaochuan, you are back!
His mother suddenly smiled, and everything before his eyes was light.
Xiaochuan thought to himself: this is happiness.
Some things do not disappear, even after a long time.

title: 新的决定
english_summary: Xiaochuan tells Lin Yuqing he wants to move back to the village. She hears him out — and backs him.
content:
小川：雨晴，我有一个决定。
林雨晴：什么决定？
小川：我想回村里工作。
林雨晴：真的吗？你不喜欢城市了？
小川：城市很好，但是我需要家人。
林雨晴：我理解你。
小川：我有点儿紧张。
林雨晴：这是你的人生，我支持你。
林雨晴：什么时候走？
小川：下个月。
林雨晴：那我们要好好庆祝一下！

title: 坚持
english_summary: Xiaohua runs her school race. She does not win — and finds that finishing was the point.
content:
小花是学校比赛的选手。
昨天的训练很困难。
她的教练说，慢慢来。
今天早上，比赛开始了。
前面的路还很长。
她很紧张，也有点儿害怕。
但是她没有停止。
教练的建议在她心里。
她终于到达了。
她不是第一，但是她很高兴。
坚持就是胜利。
english_content:
Xiaohua is a competitor in her school race.
Yesterday's training was hard.
Her coach said: take it slowly.
This morning, the race began.
The road ahead was still long.
She was nervous, and a little afraid too.
But she did not stop.
Her coach's advice stayed in her heart.
At last, she reached the end.
She was not first, but she was very happy.
To keep going is itself a victory.

title: 1. 回到村里
english_summary: Xiaochuan gets off the last train of the day and walks back into a house that has not changed in twenty years.
content:
小川的东西不多，只有一个包和一台电脑。
火车开了六个小时。
到村里的时候，天已经很晚了。
爸爸一个人在车站等他。
爸爸：路上累不累？
小川：不累，我一路在看外边。
家里的房间一点儿变化也没有。
桌子上有热茶和两个包子。
妈妈：吃吧，慢慢来。
小川吃着包子，觉得很香。
外边没有车，也没有人说话。
二十年了，这个房间还在等他。
english_content:
Xiaochuan did not bring much: one bag and a laptop.
The train ran for six hours.
By the time he reached the village, it was already late.
His father was waiting alone at the station.
Dad: Was the journey tiring?
Xiaochuan: Not tiring. I watched out of the window the whole way.
His room at home had not changed one bit.
On the table were hot tea and two steamed buns.
Mum: Eat something. Take your time.
Xiaochuan ate a bun; it smelled wonderful.
Outside there were no cars, and nobody talking.
Twenty years on, this room was still waiting for him.

title: 2. 一个决定
english_summary: Over breakfast Xiaochuan tells his parents what he came home to do: open a small restaurant by the old bridge.
content:
第二天早上，一家人一起吃饭。
妈妈：你回来了，要做什么工作？
小川：我想在村里开一个小饭馆。
爸爸看着他，很久没有说话。
爸爸：开饭馆很累，也要不少钱。
小川：我知道。这几年我存了一些钱。
妈妈：村里的人不多，生意会好吗？
小川：我不确定，但是我要做。
爸爸：这件事，你要想好。
小川：这半年我总是在想。
妈妈笑着说，那我们帮你。
桥边有一个旧房间，空了很久。
小川决定，就是那里。
english_content:
The next morning the family ate together.
Mum: Now that you are back, what work will you do?
Xiaochuan: I want to open a small restaurant in the village.
His father looked at him and said nothing for a long time.
Dad: Running a restaurant is tiring, and it takes money.
Xiaochuan: I know. I saved some money over these years.
Mum: There are not many people here — will business be good?
Xiaochuan: I am not certain, but I am going to do it.
Dad: Think this one through properly.
Xiaochuan: I have been thinking about it for half a year.
Mum smiled: Then we will help you.
By the bridge stood an old room, empty for years.
Xiaochuan decided: that was the place.

title: 3. 开门第一天
english_summary: A month of building, and then the door opens. Seven people come — the first of them his old primary-school teacher.
content:
他们准备了一个月。
爸爸做桌子和椅子。
妈妈教他做面条儿。
门口挂着一块板，上面是店的名字。
第一天早上，他六点起床。
水开了，面条儿也准备好了。
八点，第一个人进来了。
是他的小学老师。
老师：我看见门口的板了。
老师：这个村，很久没有新的店了。
小川给他做了热热的面条儿。
老师吃完，说很香。
第一天来了七个人。
晚上小川累极了，但是很高兴。
english_content:
They spent a month getting ready.
His father made the tables and chairs.
His mother taught him to make noodles.
A board hung by the door with the shop's name on it.
On the first morning he got up at six.
The water boiled, and the noodles were ready too.
At eight, the first person came in.
It was his primary-school teacher.
Teacher: I saw the board at your door.
Teacher: This village has not had a new shop in a long time.
Xiaochuan made him steaming hot noodles.
The teacher finished and said it smelled wonderful.
Seven people came that first day.
That evening Xiaochuan was exhausted — and very happy.

title: 4. 没有人来
english_summary: By the third week the shop is empty, the money is going, and Xiaochuan sits alone on the bridge remembering his city wage.
content:
开门的第三个星期，人少了。
每天只有两三个人。
面条儿卖不出去。
妈妈说，村里的人都在家里吃饭。
小川心里有点儿紧张。
钱一天一天地少了。
一天晚上，他一个人坐在桥上。
桥下的水很慢，村里没有一点儿光。
他想到了城市里的公司。
在那里，他每个月都有工资。
但是他也记得，那时候的压力。
他没有回去的意思。
只是，他还不知道明天要怎么做。
english_content:
In the third week after opening, fewer people came.
Only two or three a day.
The noodles were not selling.
His mother said the village all ate at home.
Xiaochuan felt a little anxious.
Day by day, the money grew smaller.
One evening he sat alone on the bridge.
The water below was slow; the village had not one light.
He thought of his company back in the city.
There, he had a wage every month.
But he also remembered the pressure of those days.
He had no intention of going back.
Only — he still did not know what to do tomorrow.

title: 5. 雨晴的建议
english_summary: Lin Yuqing comes down from the city with a bag of food and one idea: the village is small, but the internet is not.
content:
星期六，林雨晴从城市来了。
她拿着一个大包，里面都是吃的东西。
林雨晴：你的店我看了，很好啊。
小川：好是好，但是没有人来。
林雨晴：村里的人不多，外边的人多。
小川：外边的人怎么会知道我的店？
林雨晴拿出手机，拍了店里的面条儿。
林雨晴：网上有很多人喜欢这样的店。
林雨晴：我们在网上宣传一下。
小川：真的会有人来吗？
林雨晴：我不敢说，但是不做就没有。
那天晚上，他们一起写了一些文章。
小川第一次觉得，他不是一个人。
english_content:
On Saturday, Lin Yuqing came from the city.
She carried a big bag, all of it food.
Lin Yuqing: I have seen your shop. It is lovely.
Xiaochuan: Lovely it may be, but nobody comes.
Lin Yuqing: The village is small, but outside it there are many people.
Xiaochuan: How would people out there hear about my shop?
Lin Yuqing took out her phone and photographed the noodles.
Lin Yuqing: Plenty of people online love a shop like this.
Lin Yuqing: Let's put the word out online.
Xiaochuan: Will anyone really come?
Lin Yuqing: I cannot promise. But do nothing and nobody will.
That night they wrote a few posts together.
For the first time, Xiaochuan felt he was not alone.

title: 6. 桥边的饭馆
english_summary: Three students, then a reporter, then a full room. Xiaochuan stands on the bridge and looks at what he built.
content:
一个月过去了。
一个星期六的早上，来了三个学生。
学生：我们在网上看见你的店。
他们坐下，要了面条儿和绿茶。
下午，店里来了几个人。
还有一个城里来的记者。
记者：您为什么回村里开店？
小川想了一下。
小川：因为这里是我的家。
到了晚上，店里坐着很多人。
妈妈在里面做饭，爸爸在门口帮忙。
小川站在桥上，看着自己的店。
店里有光，也有人在笑。
他知道，这条路还很长。
但是他已经开始走了。
english_content:
A month went by.
One Saturday morning, three students turned up.
Student: We saw your shop online.
They sat down and ordered noodles and green tea.
In the afternoon, more people came into the shop.
Among them was a reporter from the city.
Reporter: Why did you come back to the village to open a shop?
Xiaochuan thought for a moment.
Xiaochuan: Because this is my home.
By evening the shop was full of people.
His mother cooked inside; his father helped at the door.
Xiaochuan stood on the bridge, looking at his own shop.
There was light inside, and people laughing.
He knew this road was still long.
But he had already started walking it.

title: 1. 教练的电话
english_summary: Xiaohua did not win her school race — so why is her coach calling about a final in the city?
content:
比赛结束的第二天，教练打来电话。
教练：下个月在城里有一个决赛。
小花：我可以去吗？我不是第一。
教练：上次你没有停止，这个我记得。
小花拿着电话，很久没有说话。
她想到了上次比赛的最后一分钟。
那时候，她的身体很痛。
但是她到达了。
小花：教练，我去。
教练：那从明天开始训练。
教练：这一次，我们的目标是决赛。
晚上，她把这件事告诉了妈妈。
妈妈没有说话，只是看着她，慢慢笑了。
english_content:
The day after the race, the coach rang Xiaohua.
Coach: There is a final in the city next month.
Xiaohua: Can I go? I did not come first.
Coach: Last time you did not stop. I remember that.
Xiaohua held the phone and said nothing for a long while.
She thought back to the last minute of that race.
Her body had hurt then.
But she had reached the end.
Xiaohua: Coach — I'll go.
Coach: Then training starts tomorrow.
Coach: This time our goal is the final.
That evening she told her mother about it.
Her mother said nothing, only looked at her and slowly smiled.

title: 2. 对手
english_summary: The training gets harder, and the final has a name in it: Xiaohong, last year’s winner. The coach sets a different target.
content:
训练比上次更加困难。
每天早上五点，她已经在路上跑步。
教练：速度很好，但是你要学会等待。
大力告诉她，决赛里有一个强大的选手。
大力：她叫小红，是去年的第一。
小花在网上看了小红的比赛。
小红跑得非常快，也非常准。
小花心里产生了一个问题：她能赢吗？
教练：你不必赢她。
教练：你要做的，是比昨天的自己快。
小花记得教练的每一个字。
english_content:
Training was harder than last time.
At five every morning she was already out running.
Coach: Your speed is good, but you must learn to wait.
Dali told her the final had one very strong competitor.
Dali: Her name is Xiaohong — last year's winner.
Xiaohua watched Xiaohong's races online.
Xiaohong ran extremely fast, and extremely precisely.
A question formed in Xiaohua's mind: could she win?
Coach: You do not have to beat her.
Coach: What you must do is be faster than yesterday's you.
Xiaohua remembered every word the coach said.

title: 3. 受伤
english_summary: Ten days before the final, her body gives out in training. The doctor will not make the decision for her.
content:
决赛前的第十天，意外发生了。
下午的训练里，她的身体突然很痛。
她坐在地上，一动也不动。
教练赶紧跑过来。
教练：哪里痛？
小花：这里……我站不起来。
医院里，医生看了很久。
医生：不是重大的伤，但是要休息十天。
小花：十天后就是决赛。
医生：那你自己判断。
回家的路上，她一路没有说话。
妈妈：你在想什么？
小花：我想，我是不是不能去了。
妈妈：那也没关系。
小花：但是我准备了三个月。
english_content:
Ten days before the final, the accident happened.
In that afternoon's training, her body suddenly hurt.
She sat on the ground and could not move.
The coach came running over.
Coach: Where does it hurt?
Xiaohua: Here… I cannot stand up.
At the hospital, the doctor examined her a long time.
Doctor: It is not a serious injury, but you need ten days' rest.
Xiaohua: The final is ten days from now.
Doctor: Then that is your own call.
On the way home she did not speak at all.
Mum: What are you thinking about?
Xiaohua: I am thinking that maybe I cannot go.
Mum: That would be all right too.
Xiaohua: But I prepared for three months.

title: 4. 等待
english_summary: Ten days of not running. Xiaohua watches instead — and finds the one place where the fastest runner in the country is slow.
content:
十天很长。
她每天早上还是五点起床。
但是她不能跑，只能看别人跑。
教练给了她一些新的任务。
教练：看比赛，观察别人的速度。
教练：身体在休息，头可以工作。
小花坐在旁边，看了很多次比赛。
她注意到，小红在最后一分钟总是很快。
但是开始的时候，小红比较慢。
这个情况，小花记得。
第九天，她慢慢走了一会儿。
身体还有一点儿痛，但是可以动了。
教练：明天你自己决定。
那天晚上，小花很久没有睡。
english_content:
Ten days is long.
She still got up at five every morning.
But she could not run — she could only watch others run.
The coach gave her some new tasks.
Coach: Watch the races. Observe how fast the others are.
Coach: The body rests; the head can still work.
Xiaohua sat at the side and watched race after race.
She noticed that Xiaohong was always fast in the final minute.
But at the start, Xiaohong was slower.
Xiaohua remembered that.
On the ninth day, she walked slowly for a while.
Her body still ached a little, but it moved.
Coach: Tomorrow you decide for yourself.
That night, Xiaohua lay awake a long time.

title: 5. 决赛那天
english_summary: The final, in front of a full house. Xiaohua does not win it — and walks away having learned the thing she came for.
content:
决赛那天，现场有很多观众。
妈妈和大力也来了。
小花看见小红站在前面。
教练：你观察到的，都要记得。
比赛开始了。
前面的一半，小花跑在第三。
她没有紧张，也没有太快地跑。
最后一分钟，她开始快起来。
她一点儿一点儿接近小红。
观众都站了起来。
最后，小红还是第一。
小花是第二。
她的身体开始痛，但是她在笑。
教练走过来，只说了一个字：好。
妈妈跑过来，眼睛里都是水。
小花心里想，上次她学会了坚持。
这一次，她学会了等待。
english_content:
On the day of the final, the venue was full of spectators.
Her mother and Dali came too.
Xiaohua saw Xiaohong standing at the front.
Coach: Remember what you observed.
The race began.
For the first half, Xiaohua ran in third.
She was not nervous, and she did not run too fast.
In the last minute, she began to speed up.
Bit by bit she closed on Xiaohong.
The spectators all rose to their feet.
In the end, Xiaohong was still first.
Xiaohua was second.
Her body began to hurt again, but she was smiling.
The coach walked over and said a single word: good.
Her mother ran over, her eyes full of tears.
Xiaohua thought: last time she learned to keep going.
This time, she learned to wait.

title: 面条儿的价格
english_summary: Xiaochuan and his mother count the day’s takings and argue gently about the price of a bowl of noodles.
content:
妈妈：今天来了多少人？
小川：十二个。比昨天多。
妈妈：这样下去，钱怎么样？
小川：太少了。面条儿太便宜了。
妈妈：那你要不要调整一下价格？
小川：我想过。但是村里的人钱不多。
妈妈：那就这样，慢慢来。
小川：我再想一个新的方式。
妈妈：不要太累了。
小川：知道了，妈妈。

title: 决赛前的晚上
english_summary: The night before the final, Dali messages Xiaohua. You answer as Xiaohua.
content:
大力：明天几点开始？
小花：早上九点。我已经准备好了。
大力：你的身体怎么样？
小花：还有一点儿痛，但是可以跑。
大力：不要太紧张。
小花：我不紧张。我等了很久。
大力：我和你妈妈都会去现场。
小花：真的吗？太好了！
大力：那明天见。
小花：明天见。

title: 桥边的早上
english_summary: Six in the morning by the bridge, one picture at a time, before the shop opens.
content:
🌅 早上六点，村里还没有人。
🌉 小川一个人走到桥上。
💧 桥下的水很慢。
🐦 外边有几只鸟。
🍜 店里的水已经开了。
☀️ 阳光进来了，桌子上都是光。
😊 小川笑了。
english_content:
Six in the morning; nobody in the village yet.
Xiaochuan walks out onto the bridge alone.
The water under the bridge is slow.
A few birds are outside.
The water in the shop has already boiled.
Sunlight comes in; the tables are covered in light.
Xiaochuan smiles.
